notes.title: The Closed Beta is almost here!
notes.content:
[p]Are you ready to become one of the very first recruits of the galaxy’s most chaotic Clean-Up Crew?[/p][p]We’re preparing for our [b]Closed Beta[/b], and while it’s not quite ready yet, it’s just around the corner!
If you want to be among the first to try out [b]Vacunauts [/b]in it's early state and help us shape the future of the game with your feedback, make sure to follow us here on Steam or join our [url="https://discord.gg/tpUwJyybhK"]Discord[/url][url="https://discord.gg/6GMbSVn9nH"] [/url]community.[/p][p]Don’t miss your chance to jump into the mess early! We’ll let you know the moment sign-ups go live.

[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136293/2fa578f20490a09c06f6d5924d0c6c916809aec3.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Stack 'Em Up at the Gamescom 2024!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45136293/761bbed0d29992b9322d6d7b141399597bb3ff60.png[/img]

[b]Ready for some impressive news?[/b]

We are excited to announce, that Stack 'Em Up will be exhibiting at the upcoming Gamescom 2024!! And we are happy to join the famous Indie Arena Booth!

We can't wait to share our passion with you and would like to invite everyone to visit our booth, where you can test our latest game and get an exclusive first look at its features.
Whether you're a longtime fan or new to our community, we'd love to meet you and hear your feedback.
Join us for an unforgettable experience. See you there!

[i]Cologne Trade Fair Centre Germany[/i]
[i]21.08.2024 - 25.08.2024[/i]
[b]Hall 10.2, Indie Arena Booth 15[/b]
